Test Case: Validate that a dedicated Metering section is available within each Subscription Plan in the Metering Flow
Validate that the Enabled Metering Components subsection displays all metering components currently enabled for the subscription plan
Validate that the Available Metering Components subsection displays all metering components configured at the Stream level but not yet enabled for the subscription plan
Validate that users can toggle between Table View and Tile View in the Enabled Metering Components section
Validate that users can toggle between Table View and Tile View in the Available Metering Components section
Validate that an enabled metering component can be deleted when there are no active subscriptions associated with the subscription plan
Validate that deletion of an enabled metering component is blocked when active subscriptions exist for the subscription plan
Validate that users can review available metering components and configure them against the subscription plan
Validate that once an available metering component is configured, it moves from the Available section to the Enabled section
Validate that a newly configured metering component no longer appears in the Available Metering Components list after being enabled
